title.narrative: UNICEF accelerated government efforts to strengthen child focused public financing by supporting institutionalisation of child budgeting in 11 states and promoting a standardised approach to tracking public expenditure on children. A jointly led monitoring mechanism by the Ministries of Finance and Women and Child Development further advanced accountability for child related spending. UNICEF's advocacy with national and state finance bodies promoted greater fiscal devolution for child centred services, while technical support helped advance innovative financing models for the care economy, contributing to expanded fiscal space and more equitable investments for children.
